test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An airplane covers a certain distance at a speed of 400 km/hr in 8 hours. To cover the same distance in 5 hours, the speed of the airplane will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed and Time are inversely proportional.

Time ratio = 8 : 5

Speed ratio = 5 : 8

Initial speed (5 units) = 400 km/hr

New speed (8 units) = (400 ÷ 5) × 8 = 640 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 640 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Speed (S₁) = 400 km/hr

Initial Time (T₁) = 8 hours

New Time (T₂) = 5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b60a5a0704880b5454f6a47f4357e082782952c50715f1e723de6e045bfa119.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = S₁ × T₁

⇒ Total Distance = 400 × 8 = 3200 km

⇒ New Speed (S₂) = Total Distance ÷ T₂

⇒ New Speed = 3200 ÷ 5

⇒ New Speed = 640 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 640 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

When moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. When moving in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Proportionality of Distance, Speed, and Time

If Distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1 ÷ Time. If Time is constant, Distance ∝ Speed.
